name: Huashu Design
hook: HTML-native design skill for Claude Code by creator 花叔 with 22K stars, 20 design philosophies, 18+ style presets (Art Deco, Bauhaus, pixel art), high-fidelity prototype output, and MP4 export. Chase AI spotlighted it as one of the top fixes for Claude Code's web design problem — a single-sentence prompt produces studio-quality HTML.

name: Higgsfield AI Skills
hook: Official Higgsfield AI skills pack (641 stars, pushed Jul 28) giving Claude Code access to 30+ image and video models: Veo 3.1, Kling 3.0, Seedance 2.0, Flux 2, GPT Image 2, and Higgsfield-exclusive Soul and Cinema Studio models. Chase AI featured it as the MCP-style solution for adding AI image/video generation directly from the terminal.

name: Skills Janitor
hook: "Tinder for your Claude Code skills" — 6-command, zero-dependency shell tool that audits installed skills by token cost and usage, then surfaces them as swipeable cards sorted heaviest-least-used-first. Claimed 30–40% context reduction before the deck ends. Also scans for prompt injection and broken symlinks. Works with Claude Code and Codex.

name: Buzz (by Block)
hook: Jack Dorsey's Block released Buzz (20.9K stars, active today) — a self-hostable Rust workspace where humans and AI agents share the same channels and project repos as first-class members. Claude Code, Codex, and Goose connect via the ACP protocol. Chase AI's video "Claude Code + Codex Can FINALLY Work Together" drove this into viral circulation on July 29.

name: Claude Skills: Journalism
hook: 350-star Claude Code skills collection for journalism and academia, pushed today (Aug 2). Covers FOIA requests, OSINT investigations, deepfake and source verification, data journalism, narrative tracking, and academic writing. Fills a domain niche that generic coding-focused skill packs miss entirely.

name: glebis/claude-skills
hook: 337-star community skills collection (pushed Jul 29) with a notable design and i18n focus: recent additions include font-features, typography, Nielsen heuristics evaluation, i18n translation workflows, pre-session-portrait, and release orchestration — a well-maintained set aimed at designers and product engineers.

name: Fusion Harness
hook: 245-star Pi coding agent extension that fuses frontier models instead of racing them: Claude Fable 5 in the ARCHITECT slot, GPT-5.6 Sol in the BUILDER slot, with /opinion, /fusion, and /auto-validate slash commands for two-model agentic engineering. IndyDevDan featured it in his "Ultimate Coding Agent" video combining Pi, Codex, and Claude Code.

name: mcp-explorer
hook: Zero-install CLI tool (46 stars, pushed Aug 1) by Simon Willison for interactively probing any MCP server — list tools, run calls, inspect schemas, all from the terminal. Built specifically in response to the stateless MCP 2026-07-28 spec. Works via uvx with no local install required.

name: Netresearch Claude Code Marketplace
hook: Curated portable agent skills collection (51 stars, pushed today) following the open agentskills.io standard — installable across Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, Codex, Gemini CLI, and 30+ other agents with a single command. Maintained by German software firm Netresearch as an enterprise-grade alternative to single-vendor skill packs.
